closing.summary: Big strengths are protein, magnesium, and holds up as a better snack default than most packaged options, but the biggest weaknesses are low vitamin E, low omega 3, and low fibre. It is good for bone health, muscles and strength sports, and immune support because magnesium gives the bone-health case something to work with, the protein section supports repair and maintenance, and zinc gives the immune-support side a reason to exist.
